source.author: verg
source.text: Testor, cara, deos et te, germana, tuumque dulce caput, magicas invitam accingier artes.
source.text_original: Testor, cara, deos et te, germana, tuumque / dulce caput, magicas invitam accingier artes.
source.text_english: I call the gods to witness, dear one, and you, my sister, and your sweet head, that I am being forced against my will to take up magical arts.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: da, precor, amplexus haesuraque verba relinque auribus et dulci iam nunc preme lumina dextra.
reuse.text_original: da, precor, amplexus haesuraque verba relinque / auribus et dulci iam nunc preme lumina dextra.
reuse.text_english: Give me, I beg, your embrace, and leave your words to cling to my ears, and now at last close my eyes with your sweet right hand.
